items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: He said, 'Well, I'm Bud Rankin.' I said, 'Hi, Mr. Rankin.'

ctx.x: The first night there, it was on a Sunday and I must have gotten there around 5 or 6 o'clock ... I met a tremendous fellow who am there whom I, I'm the kid in short pants. But, he had a gig at a place called Moreau. I don't know why I'll never forget it. His name was Bud Rankin.
What was the name of the place?
